article_notes: AKI identification and IRIS staging in dogs with babesiosis or leptospirosis (Kerala). Reports AKI frequency (19/129 babesiosis dogs) and the IRIS stage distribution (Table 4), and clinical signs of the 36 AKI dogs pooled across both diseases (Table 3). No marker or host factor is compared between dogs with and without AKI or between stages. Nothing to extract.
